description: This file defines the FooTable.Breakpoints class, which manages responsive breakpoints for a table component, including calculating current breakpoint, applying CSS classes, and handling breakpoint changes.

classes.name: FooTable.Breakpoints
classes.description: Class managing responsive breakpoints for FooTable, including initialization, calculation, and UI updates.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Breakpoints component with table options and setting up internal state.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Pre-initialization method that processes options and sets up breakpoints array.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the breakpoints, setting the current breakpoint.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Applies the current breakpoint class to the table element.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current breakpoint based on table width.

methods.name: visible
methods.description: Determines if columns with specified breakpoints are visible.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks for breakpoint change and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a breakpoint object based on name, index, or current.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width used for breakpoint calculations.

methods.name: getParentWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the table's parent element.
